description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 002 are dark blue pool mosaic tiles supplied on sheets, shown in the product photo being laid along a pool edge, for anyone who wants deep blue water rather than a pale turquoise.

## How they look
The photo shows a glossy surface in a dark blue, laid as small squares on mosaic sheets. A glossy pool mosaic catches the light at the surface, so the lining tends to sparkle in sun while the water itself reads as a deep, calm blue.

## Where they work
- **Full pool linings**, walls and floor, for a lake-like look.
- **Pool edges and steps**, where small pieces follow curves and level changes more easily than large tiles.
- **Spa pools and water features**, where deep blue pool tiles give a richer colour in a small space.

Mosaic sheets are generally quicker to lay than loose pieces and suit curved pool shapes, which is why many builders prefer them for pools.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: dark blue, glossy, small-square mosaic on sheets (from the product photo)
- Size, thickness and sheet format are not listed online yet; confirm them before you work out quantities.

Ask your contractor about a pool-grade adhesive and grout, keep grout lines even across sheet joins, and order a little extra from the same batch for future repairs.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), compare it with a turquoise option such as [Swimming Pool Tiles 001](/products/swimming-pool-tiles-001), and send your pool size for a dated quote. See the full [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of dark blue pool mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are mosaic sheets good for curved pools?
faqs.a: Yes, generally. Small pieces on a sheet bend around curves and steps more easily than large tiles, which is why mosaic is a common choice for pool shapes that are not simple rectangles.

faqs.q: Does dark blue make a pool look deeper?
faqs.a: It usually does. A dark lining absorbs more light, so the water looks deeper and calmer, while a light lining makes the floor look closer and the water brighter.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
